NBA DFS Rankings for Monday, October 26 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Monday, October 26 · 7 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 26, 8:30 AM ET

Giannis Antetokounmpo (MIA) ranks first on the Monday, October 26 DraftKings main slate at 58.7 projected DraftKings points for $9,900. Jayson Tatum (BOS, 54.1) and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 49.9) are next.

The table ranks the top 100 of 101 players in the run by SPAGS projection, with DraftKings salary and projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 26, 8:30 AM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.
